scenarios.name: same-repo-local-chain
scenarios.given: Parent repo has #12 and #19, where #19 depends on #12.
scenarios.expect: Launch one detached lane on issue_<epic-number> that processes #12 then #19, and opens one combined draft PR.

scenarios.name: independent-cross-repo-lanes
scenarios.given: Parent repo has ready #12 and another repo has ready #55 with no dependency edge.
scenarios.expect: Launch two detached worker sessions without switching the initiating tmux client.

scenarios.name: cross-repo-next-wave
scenarios.given: Repo B #55 depends on repo A #12, and #12 has no completed entry in a lane PR.
scenarios.expect: Launch repo A only, report repo B as waiting, and require a later workon invocation after repo A records #12 as reviewed and committed.

scenarios.name: external-multi-ticket-branch
scenarios.given: An external repo has #55 then #61 in dependency order.
scenarios.expect: Use issue_55 for that lane and reuse its existing parent-epic draft PR on later waves.

scenarios.name: existing-worker
scenarios.given: The target worktree and tmux session already exist.
scenarios.expect: Report the existing worker and do not create a duplicate session or switch clients.

scenarios.name: external-epic-from-another-repo
scenarios.given: Workon is invoked for another repository's epic while the current directory is a different repository.
scenarios.expect: Clone or reuse the epic repository as a sibling; never create a branch in the current unrelated repository.
